She places her hands on her hips and adjusts her posture to showcase the structural lines of the clothing. (5) The final sequence features rapid cuts between poses where she wears the black tank top and white pants. She holds a red soda can as a prop, moving her head to an unseen rhythm while the camera captures varying shot sizes from close-up to medium full shot.
